findings.title: A spoken answer held for inquiry
findings.claim: Within the pericope's gathering-and-answer frame, the disciples' profession in the focus is both a remembered reply and a response placed under divine attestation for the question of how messengers were answered.
findings.mechanism: The focus forms قَالُوا and وَاشْهَدْ carry a completed spoken response and a request for witness; 5:109 supplies يَجْمَعُ, أُجِبْ, قَالُوا, and الْغُيُوبِ, so the reply meets a gathering that asks for received answers and defers unseen custody to God.
findings.reader_payoff: The profession can be heard as an answer that remains available for final review while its ordinary past-scene dialogue stays audible.
findings.containment: This is an attributed macro resonance, not a claim that the passage describes a literal archive or that the future-inquiry reading replaces the remembered scene; the supplied alternative is a past favor with no archival function.

epistemic.reason: The HFT anchor coverage is complete and its coordinates and roots agree with supplied context occurrences, but the reader identity is legacy_unbound and the contextual branch records have no independent lexicon registration.

findings.title: Enablement reaches the helper body

findings.mechanism: The focus carriers أَوْحَيْتُ and الْحَوَارِيِّينَ meet 5:110's outside-conferred strengthening, enabled speech, and teaching; the repeated divine-action frame changes the following inspiration toward the helpers into a continuation of enablement from messenger to respondent community.
findings.reader_payoff: The disciples become newly perceptible as a responsive extension of the mission, with their answer carrying forward capacities already shown as given from outside.
findings.containment: This does not give the helper group Jesus's signs or independent authority; the live alternative is that the final وَإِذْ introduces a separate favor without a transmission arrow.

epistemic.reason: The HFT coordinates agree with the supplied 5:110 and 5:111 surface evidence, while the contextual branch identity is unresolved and the reader source is legacy_unbound.

findings.title: Profession before embodied reassurance

findings.mechanism: The focus's repeated أَمَنَ and its witness request meet 5:112's renewed believer label and request for a descending table, then 5:113's ordered aims to eat, settle the hearts, know the truth, and become witnesses; the later sequence turns verbal profession into a beginning that can be tested and embodied.
findings.reader_payoff: Belief becomes perceptible as a lived movement from assent toward settled, verified testimony without making the first profession insincere.
findings.containment: This is not a denial of the disciples' belief; the supplied alternative is that the request exposes a contradiction or functions only as a test of capability, and the focus's ordinary profession remains intact.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace has complete supplied anchors and exact focus/context coordinates, but its reader identity is legacy_unbound and the contextual branch records remain attributed rather than independently registered.

findings.title: Witness beyond human presence
findings.claim: The witness requested in the focus is opened toward a witness that remains after the messenger and the speakers leave the scene, so the disciples' self-description can be tested beyond immediate human presence.
findings.mechanism: The focus وَاشْهَدْ carries a direct request for attestation; 5:117 limits Jesus's witnessing to the time he is among the people, then names God as watcher and witness after that boundary, while 5:119 makes truthfulness consequential on the day of benefit.
findings.reader_payoff: The appeal for witness gains a temporal depth in which the profession is not stranded when human observation ends.
findings.containment: This does not turn the focus into a prediction or erase its present-time appeal; the supplied alternative is an immediate prayer with no forward custody, and the HFT relation remains attributed.

epistemic.reason: The exact HFT trace agrees with supplied 5:117 and 5:119 coordinates and its anchor scope is complete, but the reader identity is legacy_unbound and several context branches lack independent registry records.

findings.title: The messenger within the gathered messenger scene
findings.claim: The focus's possessive 'my messenger' is heard within the surrounding scene of gathered messengers as an answer-bearing messenger whose mission belongs to a wider field of response and accountability.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier رَسُولِي names a messenger carrying a sender's message; 5:109 supplies الرُّسُل in the gathering and asks what answers they received, so the individual messenger reference meets a collective answerability frame.
findings.reader_payoff: Belief in the messenger gains a communal and accountable horizon rather than remaining only an isolated relationship between the disciples and one named envoy.
findings.containment: This does not identify the focus messenger as literally present in 5:109 or erase the direct focus relation; it is a qualified pericope resonance from a repeated messenger field.

epistemic.reason: The focus branch and both Arabic occurrences are supplied, but the context projection does not supply full target morphology and the cross-ayah interpretation is an authoring inference without a dedicated support record.

findings.title: Submission enacted in worship
findings.claim: The focus's closing identity 'we are submitted' is given an enacted pericope form by the later command to worship God, so the label can be heard as obedience made visible in action.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier مُسْلِمُونَ names the group through the submission-to-command branch; 5:117 supplies the independent worship command اعْبُدُوا, making the identity meet a concrete act of religious obedience.
findings.reader_payoff: The final self-description becomes more than a group name: it points toward the practiced posture of receiving and carrying out God's command.
findings.containment: This does not claim that 5:111 quotes 5:117 or that the disciples are the direct grammatical addressees of that later report; the ordinary identity reading remains intact and the relation is a bounded pericope resonance.

epistemic.reason: The focus branch and the context worship occurrence are supplied, while the connection between them is a discovery inference without a dedicated candidate or support record.
